dialog.onchain.body: SatSage reconstructs from the blockchain when sats reached or left these wallet addresses. That is an on-chain record, not a complete proof of acquisition. It does not replace exchange histories, purchase receipts, bank statements, or similar documents — it can only complement them. Whether a cut-off date or holding period applies is not decided by this program. Whether spending green sats is actually tax-free has not been conclusively settled. No one accepts liability if taxes nevertheless become due.

sanctions.heading: Sanctions check
sanctions.hintFallible: Lists contain errors and go stale.
sanctions.hintMultiList: The count per source counts that source's addresses. The same address can appear on several lists — so the sum can exceed the total.
sanctions.meta: Checks your UTXOs' history xpub-blind (third-party view, no XPUB knowledge) against sanctions and blacklists — up to the chosen hop depth. Reuses origin/tx cache; follow-up runs often skip another chain walk. Green = no listed address in that window. Detected CoinJoins (shape heuristic) are highlighted.
sanctions.noListsHint: Nothing downloaded yet. Without lists the check finds nothing — that is not a clean bill of health.
sanctions.note1: A hit does not mean your coins are “banned” — only that an address in the history is on a list. With many hops the number of checked addresses grows fast; the run then takes longer.
sanctions.note2: The result stays stored locally and is shown again when opening this view — as of when it was produced. It ages: lists change, and new UTXOs are not covered. After wallet changes, re-check or discard.
sanctions.selfCheckHint: This checks whether an address itself is listed. Whether the sats came from a listed source is answered only by the origin analysis.
sanctions.startTitle: Checks holdings xpub-blind up to hop depth (like a third party without XPUB): every prevout address counts. Green = no sanctioned address in the window. Can take minutes depending on depth.
settings.deadlines.acquisitionTitle: Defensive: the UTXO is fully green only with no grey and no orange lot share. Offensive: the total counts only the green share, not the oldest date as 100 %.
settings.deadlines.applyTitle: Writes cut-off, holding period, and acquisition reading into .env. Tax year then uses them.
settings.deadlines.cutoffTitle: Empty: holding period applies to all acquisitions. Set date: acquisitions afterwards do not become tax-free by holding (Austrian new assets, 2021-02-28).
settings.deadlines.hint: Holding period prefilled with 1 year (Germany, § 23 EStG). Cut-off empty: the period applies to all acquisitions. Acquisition from origin: default defensive — the UTXO is fully green only when no grey and no orange lot share remains. Offensive counts only the green share in the total (foreign or coinbase ends left of the holding boundary), not the oldest date for the whole UTXO. Grey and orange stay open. Known private holding periods in Europe (as of 2026 — not tax advice): Germany 1 year, Portugal 1 year, Czechia 3 years, Luxembourg 6 months. Switzerland: private disposal gains usually tax-free without a period. Austria: after the 2022 reform, no tax-free status by holding. Known cut-off: Austria 2021-02-28 (BMF, legacy) — acquisitions afterwards (new assets) do not become tax-free by holding. Other European countries have no comparable cut-off.
settings.deadlines.holdingTitle: Default 1 year (Germany, § 23 EStG). Other countries: Czechia 3 years, Luxembourg 6 months, Portugal 1 year.
settings.deadlines.title: Deadlines and cut-off
settings.deadlines.zusatz: Holding period for tax-free status; optional cut-off like Austrian legacy holdings

tax.historyAllTitle: Fetches the histories of all wallets — including spent amounts. Single wallet: History in the wallet view. Same cache. Needs an Electrum server.
tax.holdingTitle: Years until tax-free. Default 1 year (Germany). Multi-year periods in the dropdown.
tax.loadCandidatesTitle: Loads tax-year outflows and open UTXOs as what-if.

tax.metaHtml: Histories fetches which amounts ever existed, including long-spent ones — only then do disposals become visible. Missing origin (gray scorecard) is cleared with trace there — acquisition back to cutoff/holding period.
tax.originAllTitle: Only UTXOs without origin analysis (gray scorecard/dots). Traces back to before the cutoff date or start of the holding period — or to external/coinbase. Dots then turn yellow or green.

tax.yellowAlreadyDone: Yellow UTXOs are already fully clarified (green or confirmed yellow).

tools.addressHeading: Check an address: does it belong to one of your wallets?
tools.addressLead: Derives from the wallets on file whether the address belongs to one of them. No balance, no history, including an address that has never been used.

tools.invalid: That is not a Bitcoin address.
tools.isMineTitle: Checks locally against the wallet keys — no node, and it does not matter whether sats were ever there.

trace.arrivalTitle: Shows the stored origin, or computes it once.

trace.cacheMissing: Stored origin unreadable. “Rescan” starts a fresh analysis.
trace.cancelTitle: Cancels the run. Origin already computed is kept.
trace.cancelled: Cancelled. Expanding again restarts the analysis.
trace.coinbaseNote: Freshly mined sats — every origin ends here.
trace.coinjoinOwnOnlyEmpty: Only own coinjoin inputs are followed — no further own predecessors found here.
trace.expandAllTitle: Open the entire origin chain at once.
trace.externalNotFollowed: External branches are not followed further.
trace.focusHint: Only this UTXO — jumped from the wallet view.
trace.folgeBundledConfirm: Resolve bundled inputs? On large batch txs all inputs are resolved — this can take a while. Cancel does not start the job.
trace.folgeBundledHint: Inputs bundled — acquisition date may be newer than shown (lower bound).
trace.folgeBundledTitle: On large batch txs, resolves all own inputs (opt-in beyond the 20-input limit).
trace.folgeDoneHint: Origin gaps were followed up. “Rescan” resets the state.
trace.folgeDoneTitle: Remaining own inputs of large batch txs and predecessor txs were already followed up. “Rescan” resets the state.
trace.folgeLueckenConfirm: Close origin gaps? Loads remaining own inputs of large batch txs and follows own predecessor txs further — can take a while. Cancel does not start the job.
trace.folgeLueckenHint: Branched or bundled inputs: optionally follow up fully. Otherwise the acquisition date is only a lower bound. Detected coinjoin/mix follows only own inputs — peers are noise.
trace.folgeLueckenTitle: Loads remaining own inputs of large batch txs (e.g. consolidation) and follows own predecessor txs further. CoinJoin already uses own-only. Can take a while. Cancel in the dialog starts nothing.
trace.folgeSuggestHint: Branched origin — predecessor txs can be analyzed further.
trace.folgeTxConfirm: Analyze predecessors more thoroughly? This can cost many fetches and take a while. Cancel does not start the job.
trace.folgeTxTitle: Walks each already found own predecessor transaction and follows its inflows further.
trace.followedCached: Origin is stored — expanding shows it immediately.
trace.followedStale: Known wallet addresses changed since this trace — “Rescan” refreshes the tree.
trace.heading: Trace origin
trace.completeRescanTitle: Continues the stored tree. Finished branches stay; missing hops are filled in. The run writes logs/vervollstaendigen.log.
trace.completeGapsTitle: Unpacks bundled inputs and follows the remaining own inputs. “Scan again” leaves this gap.
trace.incompleteEmpty: Origin incomplete — no external or coinbase end (e.g. predecessor tx missing). “Rescan” continues usable partial progress.
trace.incompleteTitle: Origin incomplete (gap, cancel, or missing predecessor tx). “Rescan” / close gaps keeps finished branches and only refills gaps.
trace.meta: Walks backwards where an output's sats came from — until an external address or a coinbase. This can help when preparing origin-of-funds documentation for requests based on AML laws.
trace.missingTitle: “youngest sats” only covers UTXOs of this address that are already fully traced. The others may still show younger inflows after a full trace.
trace.noteCoinbase: Freshly mined sats — every origin ends here.
trace.noteExternalNotFollowed: External branches are not followed further.
trace.noteUnresolvedInputs: {count} further inputs were not resolved — after the first own input the resolution stops to avoid hundreds of lookups on consolidation transactions. Amounts of these inputs are missing.
trace.receivePendingTitle: Unconfirmed receive in the mempool (own Electrs) — typically change or a self-transfer.
trace.rescanTitle: Discards the stored origin tree and retraces only this UTXO — through all your XPUBs to the first external address.
trace.showAllUtxosTitle: Full origin list as via navigation.
trace.sinceAnalysisAdded: Since this trace SatSage knows {count} more wallet address(es) (e.g. after a deeper scan) — some branches might now count as internal. “Rescan” at the top of the UTXO refreshes the tree.
trace.sinceAnalysisChanged: The set of known wallet addresses changed since this trace (e.g. after a scan or a new xpub) — some branches might be classified differently now. “Rescan” at the top of the UTXO refreshes the tree.
trace.sortTitle: Sorting of open UTXOs and already spent
trace.spendingPendingTitle: Unconfirmed spend in the mempool (own Electrs). UTXO stays in the balance until confirmation.
trace.spentPendingTitle: Unconfirmed spend in the mempool — seen on your Electrs. Not in a block yet.
trace.spentTitle: This output is no longer in the balance.
trace.spentToExchangeTitle: In this spend, this amount went to a known exchange address. Fee, change, and unknown destinations are not included.
trace.startTitle: Traces a single output. Enter as txid:vout or as a bare TxID (then output 0).
trace.unresolvedInputsNote: {count} further inputs were not resolved — after the first own input the resolution stops to avoid hundreds of lookups on consolidation transactions. Amounts of these inputs are missing.
trace.clarifyAgeTitle: Traces the sats to an external address. The youngest-sats date then appears here.
trace.youngestSatsTitle: All sats are traced back to an external address. The date is the youngest inflow from outside.

wallet.fifoSpendTitleDefensive: FIFO spend · defensive: sum of this wallet's UTXOs that are fully green — no grey and no yellow lot share, the most recent external inflow lies outside the holding period. As of today ({betrag}).
wallet.fifoSpendTitleOffensive: FIFO spend · offensive: sum of the green lot shares of this wallet's UTXOs, including green/yellow mixed UTXOs (their yellow returns in the change). Yellow shares do not count; UTXOs with any grey share do not count at all (never an input). As of today ({betrag}).
wallet.fifoSpendTitleBasis: Purely from the current origin trace per UTXO, no lot accounting.
wallet.fifoSpendTitleNet: Net: minus {fee} sats fee at {rate} sat/vB ({inputs} inputs) — gross green maximum {brutto} sats. Exactly this amount can be sent, 1 sat more cannot.
wallet.fifoSpendTitleGross: Fee not yet deducted (net maximum is being calculated or is unavailable right now).
wallet.fifoSpendTitleMempool: {count} UTXO(s) are being spent in the mempool – {betrag} green deducted.
wallet.fifoSpendMempoolIncompleteTitle: Mempool state of this wallet incomplete – green sats cannot be determined reliably right now.
wallet.fifoSpendTitleUnchecked: {count} UTXO(s) without analysed origin are not counted.
wallet.fifoSpendLoadingTitle: Computing green sats from the origin …
wallet.fifoSpendWaitStartTitle: Green sats follow once startup has finished.
wallet.fifoSpendAmountTitle: Without comma/point: whole sats (e.g. 12 345 678). With comma or point: BTC – exactly one separator, at most 8 decimals (e.g. 1.01). Spaces are ignored. Allowed: more than 0 up to {max}.
wallet.fifoSpendAmountInvalidFormat: Invalid input: whole sats without separator, or BTC with exactly one comma or point (no thousands separators) and at most 8 decimals. Allowed: more than 0 up to {max}.
wallet.fifoSpendAmountInvalidRange: Out of range – allowed: more than 0 up to {max}.
wallet.fifoSpendNoRateTitle: No bitcoin rate — conversion into fiat is not possible right now.
wallet.fifoSpendStaleRateTitle: Rate older than one day (as of {stand}). Conversion is only a hint; the sat field is what counts.
wallet.fifoSpendFiatTitle: Amount in {waehrung}. Leaving the field converts into sats. Sending and coin selection use the sat field.
wallet.fifoSpendPsbtNeedsAmount: Enter a valid amount first – then destination address and fee can be set.
wallet.fifoSpendPsbtTitle: Create an unsigned PSBT (BIP174) and download it as a file – sign it in your hardware or watch-only wallet. SatSage neither signs nor sends.
wallet.fifoTargetAddressTitle: Destination address – checked live: green = own wallet, yellow = valid but external (known exchange: its name), red = invalid, wrong network or sanctions list.
wallet.fifoTargetExternal: Valid {netz} address, not in any configured wallet – external.
wallet.fifoTargetExchange: Known exchange address: “{exchange}” ({netz}). Hint from an exchange report or the label set, not a finding.
wallet.fifoTargetSanctioned: On a sanctions list: “{label}”. The PSBT is built only after an explicit confirmation.
wallet.fifoTargetWrongNetwork: Address for {adressNetz} – SatSage is running on {netz}.
wallet.fifoTargetInvalid: Not a valid Bitcoin address (characters, checksum or encoding).
wallet.fifoTargetFeeTitle: Fee rate in sat/vB (comma or point, up to 3 decimals). Rule: next-block estimate rounded up to the next whole sat/vB (at most +1); if the fee would exceed 0.1 % of the amount, 1 sat/vB applies.
wallet.fifoTargetFeeSuggested: Suggested {rate} sat/vB: next-block estimate {schaetzung} sat/vB, rounded up. Estimated {vsize} vB ({inputs} input(s), {outputs} output(s)) → {fee} sats fee.
wallet.fifoTargetFeeCapped: Suggested 1 sat/vB: at {rate} sat/vB the fee ({fee} sats for {vsize} vB) would exceed 0.1 % of the amount.
wallet.fifoTargetFeeOwn: Own value – will not be overwritten. Clear the field to use the suggestion.
wallet.fifoTargetFeeInvalid: Invalid: number above 0 up to 10,000 sat/vB, at most 3 decimals.
wallet.fifoTargetSelection: Coin selection “{strategie}”: {inputs} green input(s), {gruen} green sats, change {wechsel} sats.
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionNoChange: Coin selection “{strategie}”: {inputs} green input(s), {gruen} green sats, no change.
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionDustFee: Remainder of {staub} sats is dust (below 546) and goes to the fee.
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionDustKept: Change below 546 sats is kept: as fee it would exceed 0.1 % of the amount.
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionNonGreen: {n} mixed input(s): {sats} yellow sats return in the change to an own change address (only green sats pay the fee).
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionGreedy: Search budget exhausted – approximation (largest first) used.
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionShort: Green sats do not cover amount + fee ({gruen} eligible sats).
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionNone: No eligible green UTXOs (mempool spends, pure yellow, UTXOs with a grey share and new assets do not count).
wallet.fifoStrategyTitle:
Which green UTXOs the PSBT uses:
Little change – the combination with the smallest change; a dust remainder goes to the fee.
Low fee – largest green UTXOs first, i.e. the fewest inputs.
Oldest first – FIFO: oldest acquisition first until the amount is covered.
Clean up dust – like “Little change”, plus small UTXOs below 0.001 BTC into the change while the fee stays at most 0.1 % of the amount.
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionCleanup: Dust clean-up: {n} small UTXO(s) with {sats} sats added; they go to the change.
wallet.fifoTargetSelectionCleanupLimited: Further small UTXOs are left: otherwise the fee would exceed 0.1 % of the amount.
wallet.fifoPsbtNeedsAddress: Enter a valid destination address first (green: own wallet, yellow: external, red: sanctions list).
wallet.fifoPsbtSanctionConfirm: Do you really want to send to the sanctioned address {label}?
wallet.fifoPsbtNeedsFee: Enter a valid fee in sat/vB first.
wallet.fifoPsbtMultisigInfo: Multisig {m}-of-{n}: each cosigner signs (fingerprints {fps}), then combine and finalize.
wallet.fifoPsbtSummaryNoChange: {datei}: {inputs} input(s), no change, fee {fee} sats ({rate} sat/vB, {vsize} vB)
wallet.fifoPsbtRbf: RBF on (nSequence 0xfffffffd), nLockTime {locktime}. SatSage signed nothing and sent nothing.
wallet.fifoPsbtFingerprintXpub: No master fingerprint stored (XPUB only): paths relative to the XPUB. Electrum/Core can sign; hardware wallets need a descriptor with [fingerprint/path].
wallet.fifoPsbtMempoolUnchecked: Mempool not checked (no own Electrum server).
wallet.fifoPsbtOverMax: Amount above the green maximum ({max} sats) – holdings have changed.
wallet.fifoPsbtNotEligible: Selected UTXOs are not (or no longer) eligible.
wallet.fifoChangeRowTitle: Change of this selection ({sats} sats), yellow.
wallet.fifoUtxoToDestTitle: Of this UTXO, {sats} sats go to the destination.
wallet.emptyNoCache: No cache yet for this wallet.
wallet.emptyNoCacheHint: Balance queries addresses at the configured data source and builds the cache.
wallet.emptyNoUtxoHint: The wallet was scanned but has no balance. Is the script type correct? Wallets without SLIP-132 always export “xpub”.
wallet.fresh.behindTitle: Cache behind chain tip — use “Update” (incremental) or Rescan (full).
wallet.fresh.noneTitle: No Balance yet — list is not from the network.
wallet.fresh.oldTitle: Cache older than a day — use “Update” or Rescan.
wallet.fresh.syncingTitle: Cache is catching up to chain tip (incremental, not a full scan).
wallet.fresh.unknownTitle: UTXO cache present but without a timestamp.
wallet.historyScanTitle: Fetches this wallet's full history — including long-spent amounts. Writes the same cache that Tax year and “Already spent” read. Needs an Electrum server. Origin/acquisition date is a separate step.
wallet.noScanSpentBelow: No balance yet. Spent amounts from history are listed below.
wallet.noSpendsHint: No unspent UTXOs — spent amounts are listed below if collected.
wallet.noSpendsYet: No spends from these wallets yet.
wallet.noWalletsNavTitle: Add a wallet — opens Manage · Wallets
wallet.originDeepCancelTitle: Cancels. Already finished origin trees stay in cache.
wallet.originDeepConfirm:
Origin for “{name}”?

Every UTXO is run like “Close origin gaps” (batch inputs + predecessors) to red (external) or purple (coinbase) — may take hours. Cancel in the dialog starts nothing; cancel while running keeps already finished trees in cache.

Useful first: Rescan.
wallet.originDeepNeedCache: No UTXO cache — run Rescan first.
wallet.originDeepNothing: All UTXOs of this wallet are already fully traced.
wallet.originDeepTitle: Traces every UTXO of this wallet like “Close origin gaps”: large batch txs and own predecessor txs through to an external address or coinbase. Can take a very long time (overnight is fine). Afterwards everything sits in cache. Needs Rescan.
wallet.scanCancelTitle: Cancels only the running scan. Queued scans continue afterwards.
wallet.sortTitle: Size: largest amount first. Date: newest movement first (for spent outputs, the spend).
wallet.spentSectionTitle: Spent outputs — section stays collapsed, content is cached. Total volume = sum of face values of all spent outputs (not a net balance). Pending = unconfirmed in mempool (own node).
wallet.tipSyncNeedCache: No UTXO cache — run Rescan first.
wallet.tipSyncTitle: Light tip catch-up, same as at start when “Keep wallets up to date” is on: existing cache up to chain tip (BIP-158 incremental or Electrs light). Not a full scan — use Rescan for that.
wallet.utxoScanTitle: Re-queries this wallet's addresses at the node and refreshes the balance. Needed after new transactions. Spent amounts are not included — History next to it fetches those.
wallets.addTitle: Writes the wallet into .env immediately. Name is optional and later changeable via Update.
wallets.cacheClearAllTitle: Deletes UTXO, history, and origin cache of all wallets. Wallet age and block headers remain. Then scan again — BIP-158 from first-seen.
wallets.cacheClearReallyTitle: Delete permanently. The set is then gone.
wallets.cacheDashDiskBlocked: Writes paused: low disk (under 5% and under 2 GiB free).
wallets.cacheDashIntro: Size and coverage of local caches — not access counts.
wallets.cacheDashRefreshTitle: Re-measure file sizes and coverage — no network access.
wallets.cacheDeleteTitle: Deletes UTXO set, history, and origin for this wallet only. Then scan again.
wallets.cacheStaleTitle: Cache without a wallet in .env — can be deleted here one by one.
wallets.confirmRemove:
Remove “{name}” from .env?
Afterwards the UI asks about the analysis cache.
wallets.dangerText: Deletes the analysis cache: UTXO set, history, and origin trees. Per wallet or all at once. Wallet age (first-seen), block headers, sanctions lists, and address labels remain — the next BIP-158 scan starts at the known wallet beginning, not again at SegWit. Not undoable.
wallets.descriptorHint: Check the address first, then apply — saves immediately.
wallets.descriptorHintTitle: A multisig descriptor can look correct even if a cosigner is swapped. That is why the first receive address is shown — compare it with the wallet. Apply writes it into .env immediately.
wallets.descriptorNameTitle: Display name. Empty = placeholder. Changeable in the row after applying.

wallets.emptyList: No wallet registered yet. Enter name and XPUB below, then “Add”.

wallets.exportAddrNeedsIndexer: Fill addresses needs indexer ({name}): {n} txs stay unmatched — no Electrs/Fulcrum configured. Use “History” later.
wallets.exportAddrNoElectrs: Fill addresses needs indexer ({name}): {n} txs without address — no Electrs/Fulcrum configured. Use “History” later.

wallets.exportAlreadyPresent: Wallet “{name}” already present — cache updated from export{format}.
wallets.exportFileTooLarge: “{name}” is too large ({mb} MiB, max 25 MiB).
wallets.exportHelpHtml: Search scans the usual Sparrow/Wasabi folders. Password-protected files show a lock — no password prompt. Already in SatSage (via XPUB, descriptor, or export) are omitted. Importable e.g. Wasabi JSON (view-only/HW) and Sparrow plaintext; native Sparrow .mv.db still needs a descriptor export. Optional manual file pick.
wallets.exportImportCheckedTitle: Imports the checked, readable wallets without a password.
wallets.exportImportTitle: No selection: pick export files manually. With checked wallets from search: import those. No password.
wallets.exportImportWalletsTitle: Imports the checked wallets from the search list (no password).
wallets.exportLockTitle: Not directly readable (password or Sparrow DB) — SatSage does not ask for a password; export descriptor in Sparrow
wallets.exportSearchTitle: Scans Sparrow, Wasabi, Specter, Electrum, Ledger, BitBox and Bitcoin Core (RPC) on this machine.
wallets.heading: Wallets
wallets.importTitle: Reads an export file and checks it like pasted text. Understood: bare output descriptor (also with checksum), Bitkey External:/Internal:, Sparrow JSON, Specter JSON, and Bitcoin Core listdescriptors — receive and change are merged. Taproot multi_a and Miniscript when addresses can be derived. Not: Electrum wallet file, Caravan, Coldcard cosigner, BSMS, UR/BBQr, or anything with private keys.
wallets.importedOkTitle: Wallet export: all history addresses assigned
wallets.importedPartialTitle: Wallet export: {ohne} of {n} history entries still without address
wallets.metaHtml: Changes are written to .env. Comments and other entries are kept.
wallets.nameTitle: Display name in the list. Empty = placeholder from the key. Later changeable in the row via Update.
wallets.probeTitle: Derives addresses for each script type and asks the node which were ever used. Clarifies which type really belongs to this XPUB — with an “xpub” prefix that cannot be read off.
wallets.rowUpdateTitle: Writes this wallet's name, script type, and scan depth into .env.
wallets.sparrowAlreadyPresent: Wallet “{name}” already present — cache updated from export.
wallets.sparrowHelpHtml: SatSage detects the format. Sparrow: File → Export Wallet → Output Descriptor (+ optional CSV). Wasabi: view-only/hardware wallet JSON. No password.
wallets.sparrowImportTitle: Pick Sparrow and/or Wasabi export files. Format and names are taken from the files. Writes wallet and cache immediately — no password.
wallets.sparrowNameTitle: Display name in SatSage. Empty = filename or placeholder.
wallets.unrefDeleteTitle: Deletes UTXO/history/age files and origin data referenced only by them. No effect on registered wallets.
wallets.unrefText: Cache files from removed wallets — the UI no longer uses them.
wallets.xpubPlaceholder: Paste XPUB — zpub, xpub, ypub, vpub …
tax.greyClarifyTitle: Every UTXO still grey, i.e. with unclear history, is analysed until it turns green or yellow
tax.basisWalletEntryTitle: Only the wallet entry is known so far. A deeper trace may find an older acquisition date and satisfy the holding period.
tax.basisFromOriginTitle: Acquisition date from the origin analysis
tax.basisOutputOnlyTitle: Only the date the output was created. For change or a consolidation that is too young — the holding period may in fact be longer.
tax.rowClarifyTitle: Follow back to an external address or coinbase — may turn yellow→green or confirm yellow.
tax.timelineRunningYear: Year still running — periods calculated against today
tax.disposalsNothingSpent: Nothing was spent in this year.
tax.outflowsEmpty: No net outflows this year — history missing or nothing spent.
tax.openUtxosEmpty: No open UTXOs in the cache. Run Balance first.
tax.openUtxosHint: Tick a checkbox → report. Ticked UTXOs are counted as notionally disposed of at the cutoff (holding period / FIFO). Not an actual spend.
tax.historyHint: For orientation only: outflows above need history; UTXOs come from the balance.
tax.notAdvice: This statement is not tax advice.
tax.hintPhantom: {anzahl} history entries looked unspent but are missing from the current UTXO balance (phantom) — ignored for “Total balance”. Running the history scan again refreshes the spent flags.
tax.hintNoHistoryOne: No history is available for {wallets} — only today's balance counts there, amounts already spent are missing. “History scan” in the wallet view or “History for all wallets” closes the gap.
tax.hintNoHistoryMany: No history is available for {wallets} — only today's balance counts there, amounts already spent are missing. “History scan” in the wallet view or “History for all wallets” closes the gap.
tax.hintScope: Only UTXOs unspent at the time the statement was created are included. Amounts already spent are not covered; for past years the statement is therefore not a complete history.
tax.hintScopeWithHistory: The basis is the full history of the wallet addresses: amounts that have since been spent are included too. Disposals for the year are shown separately.
tax.hintUnchecked: For UTXOs without an origin analysis, the date the output was created applies. For change, consolidations and self-transfers that is too young — the coins already belonged to you before. The holding period is therefore **underestimated** there, never overestimated. Affected rows are marked “output date only”; an origin analysis corrects them.
tax.hintLowerBound: For some UTXOs not all external predecessors could be resolved (a batch transaction with very many inputs). The acquisition date shown there is a lower bound — the actual acquisition may be more recent and the holding period therefore shorter. Affected rows are marked “lower bound”.
tax.hintOffensive: Acquisition reading **offensive**: only the sat share whose foreign or coinbase ends lie left of the holding boundary counts as met (lot ring). A dated bundle counts as an inflow at its most recent input. Orange (on or right of the boundary) and grey (no date, gap) do not count. No longer the oldest date for the whole UTXO. With an incomplete tree the grey share stays out.
tax.hintOffensiveNoOldest: For the offensive mode the oldest inflow date is missing from the cache for some UTXOs (older origin runs). The most recent known inflow applies there for now — trace the origin again to fill in offensive correctly.
tax.hintWalletEntry: For some UTXOs an origin analysis exists, but the data source does not supply block times for the external predecessors. The most recent wallet entry applies there: for self-transfers that is too young, so the holding period is **underestimated**, never overestimated. Your own Fulcrum supplies the exact date. Affected rows are marked “wallet entry only”.
tax.hintSelfTransfer: {anzahl} transaction(s) were self-transfers — splitting, consolidating or moving between your own addresses. They are not a disposal and are therefore not listed; all that left was the network fee.
tax.hintSpentNoDate: {anzahl} spent outputs without a disposal date were not counted towards the balance (otherwise “Total balance” would be inflated by historical receipts). Running the history scan again, or an origin analysis, can fill in the times.
tax.hintCutoffRule: Cut-off rule: acquisitions after {datum} do not become tax-free by holding (Austrian “Neuvermögen”).
tax.hintRunningYear: Tax year {jahr} is still running. Periods are therefore calculated against today, not against 31/12/{jahr} — otherwise amounts whose year ends later would count as having met the period.
tax.selfTransferHint: Looks like a self-transfer — only tick it if it really was a sale.
